# My Bot Mod v1.3.3

**Minecraft 1.20–1.20.4 · Fabric** — a single codebase, 3 version-specific JARs via Stonecutter.

> Note: builds for Minecraft 1.20.5–1.21.4 (Java 21+ targets) are **not published** for this release; only 1.20–1.20.4 is supported.

## Download — pick the file matching your Minecraft version
| File | Minecraft | Java |
|------|-----------|------|
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20 – 1.20.1 | 17+ |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3+1.20.2.jar` | 1.20.2 | 17+ |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3+1.20.4.jar` | 1.20.3 – 1.20.4 | 17+ |
| `editor.zip` | Behavior editor (optional) | — |

Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API and Java 17+.

## Behavior editor (`editor.zip`) — download & usage

The optional **offline Blockly behavior editor** for programming bot behaviors with a Scratch-like visual interface (100+ blocks, dark theme, EN/中文 toggle, auto-draft). Two ways to create behaviors:

- **In-game editor** (new in v1.3.3): right-click a bot → Behavior Management → "New Behavior" — no download needed.
- **HTML editor**: grab `editor.zip` below, then:
  1. Unzip it anywhere (double-click works — fully offline, no server needed).
  2. Open `editor/behavior-editor.html` in your browser, drag blocks from the toolbox to build a behavior, then click **Save .json**.
  3. Drop the saved file into `.minecraft/config/my-bot-mod/behaviors/` (dev environment: `run/config/my-bot-mod/behaviors/`).
  4. In game, right-click the bot → **Behavior Management** → rescan folder → click a behavior to add it to the playlist → **▶ Start**. Or use commands: `/bot <name> behavior assign <file.json>` + `/bot <name> behavior start`.

`editor/examples/` inside the zip ships two ready-to-use example behaviors (Patrol Greeter, Inventory Helper) you can run directly or open in the editor to learn from. Output of both editors is the same JSON format and fully interchangeable.

## Highlights
- **Multi-version build system**: toolchain upgraded to Gradle 9.7 + Fabric Loom 1.17.19; one codebase builds every target via Stonecutter conditional comments (Fabric networking → `CustomPacketPayload`, screen extensions → `StreamCodec`, component-based ItemStack/effect serialization, `Entity.hurt` → `hurtServer`, new cross-dimension `teleportTo` signature, `HudRenderCallback`/`UseItemCallback` signature changes, …). This release publishes 1.20.1, 1.20.2 and 1.20.4 JARs (Minecraft 1.20–1.20.4).
- **In-game behavior editor**: create and edit behaviors entirely in game — category panel, statement list, parameter forms, breadcrumb navigation for nested control flow; output fully compatible with the HTML editor. "Save" writes to `config/my-bot-mod/behaviors/` and hot-reloads; export copies to any folder (server-validated, `..` rejected).
- **New export blocks**: `outputRaw` (raw line, no prefix), `outputTemplate` (custom template with `{time}` `{bot}` `{var:name}` placeholders), `outputTable` (custom header + row-append CSV); existing output blocks gain append/overwrite write modes.
- **Behavior execution UI rework**: larger panel, live status line showing the running behavior and queue progress (x/y), separate start/stop buttons, playlist ▲▼ reorder / remove / clear-all, behavior search box with per-row "run only this" and edit shortcuts.
- **Creative flight inheritance**: bots summoned while the owner is flying also enter flight and hover in mid-air (jump/sneak to rise/descend, auto-landing like vanilla creative flight); state persisted with preserveBotState.
- **Ender chest**: `/bot <name> enderchest` now opens the bot's real ender chest for live editing, auto-saved on close.
- **Smart path smoothing** (`pathfindingSmooth`, default on): width-aware line-of-sight merging of waypoints for smoother movement — only merges same-height segments whose center line and ±0.3 side clearance are standable; jump/fall/swim anchors and ravines unaffected, sampled every 0.25 blocks reusing the A* standability checks.

## Pathfinding rework & fixes

# My Bot Mod v1.3.3-beta (Preview)

**Minecraft 1.20–1.20.4 · Fabric** — ⚠️ Preview build. Behavior System v2 with major upgrades over alpha; please report issues.

## Download — pick the file matching your Minecraft version
| File | Minecraft |
|------|-----------|
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3-beta+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20 – 1.20.1 |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3-beta+1.20.2.jar` | 1.20.2 |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3-beta+1.20.4.jar` | 1.20.3 – 1.20.4 |

Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API and Java 17+.

## What's new since alpha — Behavior System v2 🧵
- **Scratch-style multi-script execution**: each hat block runs as its own thread — multiple hats run in **parallel** without blocking each other; blocks within a chain run sequentially. Waits, pathfinding and container animations suspend only their own script.
- **Per-bot behavior manager**: right-click a bot → panel → **Manage Behaviors**. Lives with the bot (no longer buried in the global config menu) and **auto-refreshes in real time** — no more reopening to see changes.
- **120+ blocks in 13 categories**: new **Lists** (12 blocks, 1-based like Scratch) and **Text** (8 blocks) categories; new event hats (receive broadcast — works **across bots**, health below X, entity nearby); wait-until, broadcast, equip/drop specific item, look at nearest entity, trig/constants, and 15 new sensors (block at, weather, daytime, nearest player, armor, air…).
- Removed the ambiguous "Loop" toggle — use the *forever* block or event hats instead.
- Reworked examples: **Patrol Greeter** (patrols forever ∥ replies when you say "你好") and **Inventory Helper** (say "盘点" to export a CSV report; "菜单" demoes lists).
- **CI fix**: GitHub Actions now uses JDK 21 (Loom 1.16 requires Gradle on JVM 21+) — builds are green again.

## 中文亮点
- 🧵 **多脚本并行**：每个帽子块一个脚本，并联执行互不阻塞（等待/寻路/开箱只挂起自己）
- 🖱 **每假人专属行为管理**：右键假人 → 行为管理，实时自动刷新
- 🧩 **120+ 积木 / 13 分类**：新增列表与文本处理分类、广播（跨假人协作）/血量/实体接近事件、等待直到、装备/丢弃指定物品、15 个新传感器
- 🔁 移除"循环"开关（用"永远重复"积木或事件驻留）；示例重做（巡逻问候、盘点助手）

Includes everything from v1.3.3-alpha and v1.3.2. Full details in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/skylhcss/my-bot-mod/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

# My Bot Mod v1.3.3-alpha (Preview)

**Minecraft 1.20–1.20.4 · Fabric** — ⚠️ Preview build: the new behavior system is fresh out of the oven; expect rough edges and please report issues.

## Download — pick the file matching your Minecraft version
| File | Minecraft |
|------|-----------|
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3-alpha+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20 – 1.20.1 |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3-alpha+1.20.2.jar` | 1.20.2 |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.3-alpha+1.20.4.jar` | 1.20.3 – 1.20.4 |

Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API and Java 17+.

## What's new — Bot Behavior System 🧩
- **Scratch-like visual editor** (`editor/behavior-editor.html`, offline, modern dark UI): 60+ blocks in 11 categories — actions, motion, containers, item/entity pickers (90+ items, 40 entities), sensing, control flow, full expressions (variables, math functions, min/max/pow), custom functions with parameters, and file output.
- **Event hat blocks**: "when behavior starts" and "when a player says …" (chat-triggered, resident listening; sender/message exposed as variables).
- **Lifelike container interaction**: if out of reach the bot pathfinds closer first, turns its head to face the container, opens it for real (lid animation + sound), then takes/puts/reads items; auto-closes afterwards.
- **External output**: behaviors write data to `my-bot-mod-exports/` as txt / JSON Lines / CSV.
- **In-game management** (press **B** → Behaviors): per-bot playlists (multiple behaviors in order), start/stop, rescan, parse-error display; `/bot <name> behavior …` commands included.
- Docs: `docs/BEHAVIORS.md` · Examples: `editor/examples/`

## 中文亮点
- 类 Scratch 的 **Blockly 图形化行为编辑器**（离线可用，现代化深色 UI，60+ 积木/11 分类，物品/实体选择器，自定义函数）
- **事件积木**：当行为启动时 / 当玩家发送"…"时（聊天触发、驻留监听）
- **容器拟真交互**：够不着先寻路靠近 → 转头看向 → 真实开箱（箱盖/声音）→ 取放/盘点 → 自动关闭
- **外置输出**：txt / JSON Lines / CSV 写入 my-bot-mod-exports/
- 游戏内行为管理页（B 键）+ 播放列表 + `/bot <名字> behavior` 命令

Includes everything from v1.3.2. Full details in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/skylhcss/my-bot-mod/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

# My Bot Mod v1.3.2

**Minecraft 1.20–1.20.4 · Fabric** — now a single codebase built for multiple versions via Stonecutter.

## Download — pick the file matching your Minecraft version
| File | Minecraft |
|------|-----------|
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.2+1.20.1.jar` | 1.20 – 1.20.1 |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.2+1.20.2.jar` | 1.20.2 |
| `my-bot-mod-1.3.2+1.20.4.jar` | 1.20.3 – 1.20.4 |

Requires Fabric Loader 0.19.2+, Fabric API and Java 17+.

## Highlights
- **Multi-version support (1.20–1.20.4)** via Stonecutter — one codebase, `gradle chiseledBuild` builds all targets. 1.20.2+ adaptations: bot registration (`ClientInformation`/`CommonListenerCookie`), common packet listener, `SavedData.Factory`, `PlayerSkin` skin mixin, `renderBackground`.
- **Config UI redesign**: browser-style tabs, crafting-table home page, bilingual (EN/中文) search box; new Pathfinding category.
- **New options**: per-player bot limit, baton-requires-OP, max pathfinding distance, parkour/swim toggles, glowing, fire immunity.
- **Per-bot settings**: 7 tri-state overrides.
- **Pathfinding**: shared per-tick budget, stuck detour/give-up, fence & headroom checks, climb fix; cross-dimension pathfinding rejected (teleport still crosses dimensions).
- **Action control** aligned with Carpet; **skin system** reverted to stable synchronous fetch.
- **Fully bilingual** messages & GUI; destructive commands require confirmation.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/skylhcss/my-bot-mod/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for full details.

releases.notes:
My Bot Mod v1.3.1 — 指挥棒 + 寻路重构

## ✨ 新功能：指挥棒（Command Baton）
两根木棍合成、不可堆叠。**手持**时屏幕左上显示模式/操作/选中假人信息，右上显示假人列表：
- `Ctrl + 滚轮` 切换模式（指挥寻路 / 传送）
- `Alt + 滚轮` 或 `Alt + 右键看向假人` 选择假人
- `右键看向某处` 让选中假人**寻路**前往或**传送**至该处

传送模式默认仅手持玩家为创造模式时可用（配置 `allowBatonTeleportNonCreative` 放开）；传送/寻路均支持**跨维度**。

## 🗺️ 寻路系统全面重构
非阻塞分帧 A*（长距离不卡服）、游泳、跨越裂谷/跑酷、危险规避、跨维度、修正到达判定、路径平滑。

## 🐛 Bug 修复
生存挖矿挖不动、配置损坏崩溃、驻留区块票据过期/跨维度泄漏、死亡重生忽略维度、假人未注册进 `playersByUUID`（改用 `placeNewPlayer`）、PNG 皮肤加载刷屏、快捷键失效、挖掘高度硬编码等。

## ⚙️ 配置变更
- `allowNonOpCreateBot` 更名为 `allowNonOpControlBot`（旧配置自动迁移）
- 新增 `allowBatonTeleportNonCreative`

## 📥 安装
需 **Minecraft 1.20.1** + **Fabric Loader 0.19.2+** + **Fabric API 0.92.8+**。下载 `my-bot-mod-1.3.1.jar` 放入 `.minecraft/mods/`。

完整更新见 [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/skylhcss/my-bot-mod/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)。
